name: Pop All The Balloons! 🎈
description:
The balloons are carrying the town away! 🏠🎈 Pop them ALL before it floats off!

HOW TO PLAY
🎯 Click or tap balloons to throw darts and pop them
⬆️ Upgrade your darts, luck and pop aura
👹 Fill each zone's meter and beat its giant BOSS balloon to open the next zone
🎈 Team up on the MEGA BALLOON every 5 minutes and the HOURLY MEGA at the top of every hour
🏭 Find the secret Balloon Factory and save the town

👥 Join our group for a gift!
🔑 Codes: LAUNCH
🎃 Halloween update: Pumpkin Darts!

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite for new zones every week!
